n: Some planet textures have failed to load. Often this means that a planet pack has broken configs, but it may also mean that you have installed it wrong. The planets listed below will likely be broken in some way. Depending on the textures involved this could be minor or the planets could be completely broken. Load your existing saves at your own risk.

t: 部分天体纹理加载失败。这通常意味着行星包配置损坏，但也可能是安装方式有误。下方列出的天体可能会出现不同程度的异常。根据受影响的纹理类型，问题可能轻微，也可能导致天体彻底损坏。加载现有存档请自行承担风险。

n: UseOriginalKSC2: Whether or not to force the original, uncompacted KSC2 to load. Will not be editable in any form by Kopernicus.
s: UseOriginalKSC2: Whether or not to force the original, uncompacted KSC2 to load. Will not be editable in any form by Kopernicus.
t: UseOriginalKSC2：是否强制加载未压缩的原版 KSC2。Kopernicus 将不会对其进行任何形式的编辑。

n: HandleHomeworldAtmosphericUnitDisplay: This is for calculating 1atm unit at home world. Normally should be checked, but mods like PlanetaryInfoPlus may want to change this.
s: HandleHomeworldAtmosphericUnitDisplay: This is for calculating 1atm unit at home world. Normally should be checked, but mods like PlanetaryInfoPlus may want to change this.
t: HandleHomeworldAtmosphericUnitDisplay：用于计算母星的 1 个标准大气压（1atm）单位。通常建议勾选，但像 PlanetaryInfoPlus 这样的模组可能希望更改此项。
